title: Affective+
description: The modpacks improve Minecraft Vanilla with "Optimization" and "Visuality"
body:
# Welcome to Affective+ Modpacks by TKZHAN
![Intro Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d14631279debe16aa7447966f3ecd38851df46a9.png)
Minecraft Java is a Popular Games for children and adult, but Minecraft Java "_Vanilla_" is leaks of features, grapics and optimization and make some of player feels no interested to play back again. So here I'am **Releasing** Affective+ a Minecraft Modpacks based on Improvement from Minecraft "_Vanilla_" comes with **Optimization, Visuality and World Generation** to Enchanced your Gameplay!

# Optimization and Mods Come Real!
![Mods Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56b0d32ade50c008670818c8fb24fb5bb77801fe.png)
Affective+ comes with a tons of popular "_Optimization Mods_" to make your performance smooth and stable while playing. You can play Minecraft with _Shaders_ or Without-it on **Low-End PC** wihtout a problem. Remember playing with _Shaders_ need strong **GPU** if you wanted to play on **60FPS and upper**. Affective+ also comes with some _Visuality Mods_ like **Falling Leaves** and **Animation Mods** and more to make your gameplay immersive.

# More on Resource-Pack
![Resource Pack Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d3ef1531feb010e0960edff1641a92176af8bfa.png)
To make Affective+ fullfill your need some _visual_ mods is not available or not exist. So I decided to add Resource-Pack to enchance **visual or grapics** along side with Resource-Pack available on modrinth.
